content: लिखित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [लिख्-क्त] Written, painted, scratched <ab>&c.</ab>; see लिख्. .{@-तः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a writer on law (mentioned along with शङ्ख). .{@-तम्@} .²1 A writing, document. .²2 A picture; द्रोणस्य चाद्य लिखितैरिव वीक्षितो यैः <ls>Ve. 3. 13</ls>. .²3 Any book or composition.
